0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 0-4 at home, 11th in the East) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-4, 1-1 at home, 12th in the West) in the Magic's eighth game of the season, with Orlando on a two-game losing streak. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee; 8.0 points and 33.4 minutes per game this season), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain; 24.5 points and 33.8 minutes per game this season), while Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with Orlando winning the last meeting 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026, and no games have been played yet between them this season.
